issues: Plan has 4 week(s) but 12 were requested.

plan.summary: This 4-week block starts the 12-week parent cycle with an off-camp build focus for boxing. Week 1 establishes simple movement baselines so the work in Weeks 2-4 can progress cleanly. With one 30-minute bodyweight-only session per week, the priority is crisp jumping power, strong single-leg and push-pull basics, productive trunk work, and just enough conditioning to support the strength-power goal without adding excess fatigue.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Build general strength and low-impact power with simple bodyweight work that is easy to recover from alongside boxing.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress force and power by making the main bodyweight patterns harder and keeping jump quality high.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Keep the strength base while shifting more of the session toward fast, sharp, boxing-friendly speed and power output.

exercises.name: 1a. Countermovement Jump
exercises.notes: Jump as high as you can with a quick dip. Stick each landing softly and rest enough to keep every rep sharp.

substitutionOptions.name: Squat Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if space is tight. Start from a still quarter squat and explode up.

exercises.name: 1b. Plyo Push-Up from Knees
exercises.notes: Explode off the floor with fast hands. Use the kneeling version so reps stay crisp and safe.

substitutionOptions.name: Fast Incline Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a bench, box, or sturdy surface if the kneeling plyo version is still too aggressive.

exercises.name: 2a. Split Squat
exercises.notes: Use a controlled lower and stand up hard. Keep the front foot flat and stay balanced.

performanceTarget.prompt: Track your cleanest set per side. Progress by adding reps only if both sides stay stable and controlled.

substitutionOptions.name: Reverse Lunge
substitutionOptions.notes: A good option if split squat setup feels awkward. Step back under control and drive up through the front leg.

exercises.name: 2b. Push-Up
exercises.notes: Stop 1-2 reps before form breaks. Keep a straight line from head to heel and press fast on the way up.

performanceTarget.prompt: Log your best clean set. Add reps gradually while leaving a little in reserve.

substitutionOptions.name: Incline Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Raise the hands on a bench, box, or table if full push-ups are not yet clean.

substitutionOptions.name: Knee Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if incline setup is not available and you still need an easier option.

exercises.name: 3a. Doorframe Row Hold
exercises.notes: Lean back and pull the chest toward the hands, then hold with the shoulder blades tight. Use a very sturdy setup only.

substitutionOptions.name: Towel Row Isometric
substitutionOptions.notes: Wrap a towel around a sturdy post and hold the top row position.

exercises.name: 3b. Hollow Body Hold
exercises.notes: Press the low back into the floor and keep ribs down. Shorten the lever if you cannot hold position cleanly.

substitutionOptions.name: Dead Bug
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if the hollow hold is too difficult. Keep the low back flat throughout.

exercises.name: 4. Shadow Boxing Tempo Intervals
exercises.notes: Stay light and relaxed. Keep hands fast, feet tidy, and breathing controlled.

exercises.name: 1a. Countermovement Jump
exercises.notes: Jump high with full intent. Stop early if height or landing quality drops.

substitutionOptions.name: Squat Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if you want a simpler jump variation with less rebound.

exercises.name: 1b. Plyo Push-Up from Knees
exercises.notes: Move explosively and keep the body rigid. Quality matters more than chasing reps.

substitutionOptions.name: Fast Incline Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a raised surface if you cannot leave the floor cleanly.

exercises.name: 2a. Split Squat
exercises.notes: Stay tall and balanced. Smooth down, strong up.

performanceTarget.prompt: Try to beat last week with one extra clean rep per side or better control.

substitutionOptions.name: Reverse Lunge
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if split squats bother the hips or feel unstable.

exercises.name: 2b. Push-Up
exercises.notes: Use the hardest version you can do cleanly while stopping before breakdown.

performanceTarget.prompt: Add reps if your body line stays solid and each rep looks the same.

substitutionOptions.name: Incline Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Lower the hand height over time as you get stronger.

substitutionOptions.name: Knee Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if full reps are still inconsistent.

exercises.name: 3a. Doorframe Row Hold
exercises.notes: Keep elbows driving back and chest proud. Do not use an unstable setup.

substitutionOptions.name: Towel Row Isometric
substitutionOptions.notes: Match the same hold time with a sturdy anchor.

exercises.name: 3b. V-Up
exercises.notes: Move with control and avoid swinging. Bend the knees slightly if needed.

substitutionOptions.name: Hollow Body Hold
substitutionOptions.notes: Use the hold if the dynamic version is too difficult.

exercises.name: 4. Shadow Boxing Tempo Intervals
exercises.notes: Short, fast bursts with clean mechanics. Stay snappy, not sloppy.

exercises.name: 1a. Countermovement Jump
exercises.notes: Every rep should look springy and fast. Reset fully between jumps.

substitutionOptions.name: Box Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a low box only if landing quality is excellent and the setup is safe.

exercises.name: 1b. Plyo Push-Up
exercises.notes: Use the floor version only if you can leave the ground cleanly without sagging. Otherwise stay with the kneeling version.

substitutionOptions.name: Plyo Push-Up from Knees
substitutionOptions.notes: Safer default if full floor plyo reps are not crisp.

substitutionOptions.name: Fast Incline Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if you need an even simpler explosive option.

exercises.name: 2a. Reverse Lunge
exercises.notes: Step back under control and drive through the front leg. Keep the torso quiet.

performanceTarget.prompt: Aim for cleaner reps or a harder variation before adding more total work.

substitutionOptions.name: Split Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if you prefer a fixed stance and better balance.

exercises.name: 2b. Push-Up
exercises.notes: Make each rep identical. Pause briefly at the bottom if you tend to bounce.

performanceTarget.prompt: Progress by improving rep quality first, then add reps.

substitutionOptions.name: Incline Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use the lowest stable surface you can manage with clean form.

substitutionOptions.name: Knee Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if full reps still break down early.

exercises.name: 3a. Doorframe Row Hold
exercises.notes: Squeeze the upper back hard and keep the neck relaxed. Use a stronger body angle only if the setup is very secure.

substitutionOptions.name: Towel Row Isometric
substitutionOptions.notes: Match the same body angle and hold quality.

exercises.name: 3b. Hollow Rock
exercises.notes: Keep the same hollow shape throughout. Make the rocks small and controlled.

substitutionOptions.name: Hollow Body Hold
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if you lose the position during rocking.

exercises.name: 4. Shadow Boxing Speed Bursts
exercises.notes: Think fast hands and relaxed shoulders. Keep the feet under you and finish feeling fresh.

exercises.name: 1a. Countermovement Jump
exercises.notes: Stay explosive but keep the total work low this week. Smooth landings only.

substitutionOptions.name: Squat Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Good choice if you feel beat up and want a simpler jump.

exercises.name: 1b. Fast Push-Up
exercises.notes: Move quickly but keep one rep in reserve. Use a simpler version if speed drops.

substitutionOptions.name: Incline Fast Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if full-speed floor reps slow down.

substitutionOptions.name: Plyo Push-Up from Knees
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if you still want a more explosive option with less stress.

exercises.name: 2a. Split Squat
exercises.notes: Keep the reps smooth and easy this week. Leave plenty in the tank.

substitutionOptions.name: Reverse Lunge
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if that pattern feels better on the knees.

exercises.name: 2b. Push-Up
exercises.notes: Clean, controlled reps only. Stop early rather than grinding.

substitutionOptions.name: Incline Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if you need to make the deload week easier.

substitutionOptions.name: Knee Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if shoulders or wrists feel irritated.

exercises.name: 3a. Doorframe Row Hold
exercises.notes: Hold a solid top position without straining. Keep the setup conservative.

substitutionOptions.name: Towel Row Isometric
substitutionOptions.notes: Use the same easy effort and hold quality.

exercises.name: 3b. Hollow Body Hold
exercises.notes: Own the position and breathe behind the brace.

substitutionOptions.name: Dead Bug
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if your low back lifts off the floor.

exercises.name: 4. Shadow Boxing Aerobic Flush
exercises.notes: Easy rhythm, loose shoulders, light feet. Finish fresher than you started.
